I shipped one item this run: the stash and bag value now show in the top right corner. It went out as v28.86 (cw-stashbag), commit e9f84be3. The gate passed. The seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

The corner readout keeps credits and XP on its main line. Under it there is now a small second line, "STASH n BAG n". It appears on the Undercroft floor and in a raid. BAG shows 0 outside a raid. The new check reads the readout text with a known stash and bag value, and it failed on the old build.

I did not take the next item on the list, "hard enemies drop better loot", because one item per run is the plan.

`evening.md` didn't exist, so I started it. It marks this item done. It also lists what git log shows already shipped and the order of the open items:
- hard enemies drop better loot
- the PRE-RAID screen
- head bars over buildings
- barrel fire damage over time
